contributions.basis: no Form A page exists in this document
contributions.detail: The PDF is ONE page: the Carr cover only. Form A (page 2) and Form B (page 3) are not present, so there is nothing to itemise and no schedule to reconcile. The Carr form prints no schedule total in any case (schedule_total null). Cover line 1 reads 90 00 (LAST) + 0.00 (THIS) = 90.00 (CUM); the LAST cell is written without a decimal point, as a gap. ESCALATION NOTE: at 600 dpi the CUM cell's second glyph is bistable 0/6 (90.00 vs 96.00). Arithmetic settles it at 90.00 and outranks the glyph, per the Rhodes rule: the cover's own identity LAST+THIS=CUM gives 90 00 + 0.00 = 90.00, and the balance line's magnitude |90.00 - 454.72| = 364.72 equals the printed balance exactly. Nothing closes under 96.00.

expenditures.basis: no Form B page exists in this document
expenditures.detail: Same as contributions: the document is a one-page cover. Line 3 reads 454 72 (LAST, written without a decimal point) + 0.00 (THIS) = 454.72 (CUM), verified in a 600 dpi crop of the whole line-3 band. Line 4 balance reads 364.72 / 0.00 / 364.72, likewise verified at 600 dpi.

gates.geometry_proof: no rows emitted, so no row geometry to prove; the four cover lines were each crop-proved at 600 dpi (line 1 band, line 1 CUM cell, line 2 band = empty rules, line 3 band, line 4 band)
gates.balance_chain: LAST + THIS = CUM closes on every printed line (90 00+0.00=90.00; 454 72+0.00=454.72; 364.72+0.00=364.72). The period identity does NOT close as signed arithmetic: contributions cum 90.00 - expenses cum 454.72 = -364.72, while line 4 prints 364.72 with no minus sign. The printed balance is therefore the MAGNITUDE of a negative balance; both figures retained verbatim, nothing recomputed. No earlier filing by this filer is in this chunk, so the cross-filing LAST-column chain could not be run here.
